summary_1line: King Nriga explains his punishment for mistakenly gifting another’s cow; Bhishma then begins the tale of Nachiketa visiting Yama and learning merits of gifting cows.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna rescues the transformed King Nriga from a deep well, after which Nriga bows and ascends to heaven in a radiant celestial chariot.
The sage Uddalaki, in sudden wrath, curses his son Nachiketa, who collapses lifeless onto the ground before the grieving father.
Yama shows Nachiketa vast heavenly realms filled with golden mansions, wish‑fulfilling trees, and rivers flowing with milk and ghee.
